Generate Plate for liquid handling and down stream analysis.
# column order SourcePlate | SourceWell | DestinationPlate | DestinationWell | Volume | Panel | Treatment | Patient
# two steps-> seed, treat 

```{r}

# MASTER plate map

master_map_list <- list()

for (i in 1:n_plate) {
  
  set.seed(1000 + i)
  
  tmp <- data.frame(
    Plate = paste0("Plate_", i),
    DestinationWell = sample(all_wells),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  tmp$WellID <- paste0(tmp$Plate, "_", tmp$DestinationWell)
  
  n_patient <- 6
  n_positive_per_patient <- 1
  
  tmp$Patient <- paste0(
    "P",
    sprintf("%02d", rep(1:n_patient, length.out = nrow(tmp)))
  )
  
  master_map_list[[i]] <- tmp
}


```

# Seeding step (linked to MASTER MAP)

```{r}

seed_source_wells <- c("A1","A2","A3","B1","B2","B3")

seed_tables <- list()

for (i in 1:n_plate) {
  
  df <- master_map_list[[i]]
  patients <- df$Patient
  
  # ADD missing column
  df$DestinationPlate <- df$Plate
  
  df$SourcePlate <- "CellPlate"
  df$SourceWell <- seed_source_wells[seq_len(nrow(df)) %% length(seed_source_wells) + 1]
  df$Volume <- 50
  
  # reorder columns safely
  df <- df[, c(
    "SourcePlate",
    "SourceWell",
    "DestinationPlate",
    "DestinationWell",
    "Volume",
    setdiff(names(df), c("SourcePlate","SourceWell","DestinationPlate","DestinationWell","Volume"))
  )]
  
  seed_tables[[i]] <- df
}


```

# Treatment step (linked to MASTER MAP)

```{r}

n_drug <- 30
drug_rep <- 2
drug_source_wells <- paste0(rep(LETTERS[1:8], each = 12), rep(1:12, 8))[1:30]

treat_tables <- list()

for (i in 1:n_plate) {
  
  df <- master_map_list[[i]]
  patients <- df$Patient
  
  # FIX: add missing column
  df$DestinationPlate <- df$Plate
  
  df$SourcePlate <- "CompoundPlate_A"
  df$Volume <- 50
  
 n <- nrow(df)

treatment <- rep(NA, n)
source_wells <- rep(NA, n)

drug_offset <- (i - 1) * n_drug
drug_ids <- sprintf("%03d", 1:n_drug)
drug_pool <- rep(drug_ids, each = drug_rep)

for (p in unique(df$Patient)) {
  
  patient_idx <- which(df$Patient == p)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1. assign 1 positive control per patient
  # -------------------------
  pos_idx <- sample(patient_idx, n_positive_per_patient)
  treatment[pos_idx] <- "Positive"
  source_wells[pos_idx] <- "POS_CTRL"
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2. remaining wells
  # -------------------------
  remaining <- setdiff(patient_idx, pos_idx)
  
  # assign controls first (same logic as before)
  n_ctrl <- min(3, length(remaining))
  ctrl_idx <- sample(remaining, n_ctrl)
  
  treatment[ctrl_idx] <- "Control"
  source_wells[ctrl_idx] <- "CTRL"
  
  remaining2 <- setdiff(remaining, ctrl_idx)
  
  # assign drugs
  treatment[remaining2] <- sample(drug_pool, length(remaining2))
  source_wells[remaining2] <- sample(drug_source_wells, length(remaining2), replace = TRUE)
}

df$Treatment <- treatment
df$SourceWell <- source_wells

  
  # reorder columns safely
  df <- df[, c(
    "SourcePlate",
    "SourceWell",
    "DestinationPlate",
    "DestinationWell",
    "Volume",
    setdiff(names(df), c("SourcePlate","SourceWell","DestinationPlate","DestinationWell","Volume"))
  )]
  
  treat_tables[[i]] <- df
}


```

# TRACEABILITY CHECK

```{r}

check_map <- function(seed, treat) {
  
  merge(
    seed[, c("WellID", "Patient")],
    treat[, c("WellID", "Patient")],
    by = "WellID",
    suffixes = c("_seed", "_treat")
  ) %>%
    mutate(match = Patient_seed == Patient_treat)
}

check_map(seed_tables[[1]], treat_tables[[1]])


```

# Export clean excel

```{r}

wb <- wb_workbook()

for (i in 1:n_plate) {
  
  wb$add_worksheet(paste0("Seed_", i))
  wb$add_data(paste0("Seed_", i), seed_tables[[i]])
  
  wb$add_worksheet(paste0("Treat_", i))
  wb$add_data(paste0("Treat_", i), treat_tables[[i]])
}

wb$save("TRACEABLE_PLATE_SYSTEM.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)



```

# Plot to plate image

```{r}

df$PlotClass <- "Drug"

df$PlotClass[df$Treatment == "Control"] <- "Control"
df$PlotClass[df$Treatment == "Positive"] <- "Positive"

plot_plate <- function(df, title, file_name) {
  
  df$Row <- factor(sub("[0-9]+", "", df$DestinationWell),
                   levels = rev(LETTERS[1:16]))
  
  df$Col <- as.numeric(sub("[A-P]", "", df$DestinationWell))
  
  df$Class <- "Drug"
  df$Class[df$Treatment == "Control"] <- "Control"
  df$Class[df$Treatment == "Positive"] <- "Positive"
  
  df$Label <- paste0(df$Patient, "\n", df$Treatment)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Col, y = Row, fill = Class)) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey80") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "skyblue3",
      "Positive" = "red3",
      "Drug" = "white"
    )) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    labs(title = title)
  
  ggsave(file_name, p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

for (i in 1:n_plate) {
  
  plot_plate(seed_tables[[i]],
             paste0("Seed Plate ", i),
             paste0("Seed_Plate_", i, ".png"))
  
  plot_plate(treat_tables[[i]],
             paste0("Treatment Plate ", i),
             paste0("Treatment_Plate_", i, ".png"))
}


```
